context: Tests whether the agent follows AEM EDS CSS conventions when implementing block styles. Covers selector scoping to the block class, use of the project's CSS custom properties, mobile-first responsive design, and anti-patterns to avoid. Rules enforced by the project's Stylelint config are not scored.

checklist.name: Block selector scoping
checklist.description: All CSS selectors are scoped with the block class (`.{block-name}`, e.g. `.testimonial-carousel .item`; a `main .{block-name}` prefix is also acceptable), not bare element names or unscoped class names

checklist.name: No unscoped selectors
checklist.description: No CSS rules use bare element selectors (e.g., `h2 { }`, `.item { }`) that are not prefixed with the block class

checklist.name: CSS custom properties for color
checklist.description: Uses CSS custom property variables for at least one color value (e.g., `var(--background-color)`, `var(--text-color)`, `var(--link-color)`) rather than hardcoded color values

checklist.name: CSS custom properties for typography
checklist.description: Uses CSS custom property variables for at least one font value (e.g., `var(--body-font-family)`, `var(--heading-font-family)`, `var(--heading-font-size-m)`) rather than hardcoded font names or sizes

checklist.name: Mobile-first default styles
checklist.description: Default (non-media-query) CSS styles represent mobile layout; larger screen styles are added inside media queries

checklist.name: Standard breakpoints
checklist.description: Media queries use 600px for tablet and/or 900px for desktop breakpoints (not arbitrary values)

checklist.name: No !important usage
checklist.description: The CSS file does NOT contain any `!important` declarations

checklist.name: Variant CSS pattern
checklist.description: If variants (dark, wide, etc.) are styled, the selector combines block and variant classes on the same element: `.{block-name}.{variant}` (optionally prefixed with `main`)

checklist.name: No -wrapper/-container suffix inside block
checklist.description: Class names used inside the block do NOT end in `-wrapper` or `-container` (to avoid conflict with platform-generated wrapper divs)

checklist.name: Gap over margin hacks
checklist.description: Flex or grid layouts use the `gap` property for spacing between items, NOT margin-based spacing tricks (e.g., `margin-left: -1rem` on container)

checklist.name: No hardcoded font families
checklist.description: Font-family values use CSS custom properties (e.g., `var(--body-font-family)`) and NOT hardcoded font names like `'Arial'`, `'Lato'`, or `sans-serif`
